calibration.convention: The digital signal is what reaches each ear; a mono file is heard in both ears. Levels state what a 1 kHz reference tone plays at.

levels.text: A 1 kHz sine at -23 LUFS (one channel) plays at 60 dB SPL; a full-scale sine plays at 80.0 dB SPL.
A 1 kHz sine at -23 LUFS (one channel) plays at 80 dB SPL; a full-scale sine plays at 100.0 dB SPL.

implementations.bs1770: pyloudnorm 0.2.0 (K-weighting filter, loudness range); listener 0.1.0 (gating on complete blocks, 0.4 s and 3 s windows, true peak, spans)
implementations.iso532_1: MoSQITo 1.2.1 loudness_zwtv stages (ISO 532-1:2017 time-varying, free field)
implementations.din45692: MoSQITo 1.2.1 sharpness_din_from_loudness on the ISO 532-1 specific loudness

bs1770.validatedOn: broadcast programme, 336 sequences, r = 0.977 with listener matches (ITU-R BS.1770-5, Attachment 1)
bs1770.outside: sound effects; pure tones and narrow-band sounds (the Recommendation says so); anything under 0.4 s
bs1770.level: independent of playback level by construction, which hearing is not

iso532_1.validatedOn: tones, noises and the technical sounds of ISO 532-1 Annex B (the implementation: within 5 % there)
iso532_1.outside: sound effects: 4 to 12 dB off on single impulsive sounds in published tests (Sottek and Moll 2015); no onset weighting or decay suppression
iso532_1.level: depends on the playback level: read each value with its calibration

din45692.validatedOn: stationary narrow-band and broadband noises of DIN 45692
din45692.outside: frames quieter than a quarter of the span's maximum are left out; a threshold on sharpness is a regression check, not a perceptual criterion
din45692.level: computed from ISO 532-1 specific loudness, so it shares its calibration

ecma418_2.validatedOn: equal-loudness contours and seven technical sounds for roughness (the standard's informative annexes); the implementation against HEAD ArtemiS 15.7 on two field recordings
ecma418_2.outside: short and impulsive sounds: no test signals exist; roughness on spans under 0.5 s

iso532_3.validatedOn: dichotic tones, noise bands, switched noise and amplitude-modulated tones (Moore et al. 2016)
iso532_3.outside: impact sounds are in its scope but not in its validation data; no single value above 5 s

notes.integrated-single-block: span under 0.4 s: 'integrated' is the span's own mean, not a gated value
notes.integrated-ungated: everything under the -70 LUFS gate: the ungated mean is given
notes.momentary-padded: span under 0.4 s: Max M counts the span as one window with silence around it
notes.short-term-padded: span under 3 s: Max S counts the span as one window with silence around it
notes.roughness-short-span: span under 0.5 s: roughness is outside what the model was built for
notes.no-playhead-document: no Playhead document: whole-file values only, which misread files with several events or long tails
notes.more-than-two-channels: more than two channels: the hearing models used the first two as ear signals

units.iso532_1: nMax, n5: sone; levelMax, level5: phon
units.ecma418_2: loudness: sone_HMS; tonality: tu_HMS; roughness: asper_HMS
